name: RS7
description: The Audi RS7 Sportback (2013–present) is the most extreme A7 variant. The 4G RS7 produced 560 hp from its 4.0-litre V8; the 4K RS7 Performance produces 630 hp. It combines the visual drama of the Gran Turismo body with supercar-level straight-line performance.
